rows.before:
"...Um.
I'm going to the restroom."
He must have been holding it in for a long time.
He was squirming his hips.
Of course, nobody stopped him, and they wondered why he'd bother announcing he was going.
But he looked around at everyone's faces, reluctant to go.
That's right.
He was scared to go alone.
The old school building late at night, already deserted and dead silent.
The six of them were the only ones there.
Anyone would be scared to walk to the restroom all alone through an old school building like that.
But nobody went with him.
With no other choice, he decided to go alone.{p}

If it's a joke, then at least we can stop worrying.

That Hanako-san had taken the six of them away.

rows.before:
First, naturally, they checked the windows.
It had been a muggy day, so the windows were left open to let in even a little breeze.
But at some point, they'd been closed.
Without a word, the three of them tried to open them.
Because once you start wondering who closed them... you just keep imagining scarier and scarier things.
But the windows wouldn't open.
It was like they'd rusted shut.
Ridiculous, right?
Those windows had been open just a moment ago.
After a few tries, someone must have hit their limit.
"I'm going home! I'm going home, I said☆"
The one shrieking wasn't the girl who'd been crying, but the one who'd been comforting her.{p}

"I'm leaving! I'm going home☆"
